title: Exact diffusion coefficients for quantum--classical hybrid walks
summary: One-dimensional quantum--classical hybrid walks are introduced by combining quantum and classical steps under periodic and random protocols. Exact diffusion coefficients are derived for both protocols throughout the diffusive regime. The exact results show how diffusion depends on the average frequency and temporal arrangement of classical steps. As the average frequency approaches zero, both diffusion coefficients diverge inversely with the frequency.
